description: Use when the user asks what one specific hotel offers (e.g. does it allow pets, is there a sauna, halal food). Returns its amenities as stated by the hotel, with section and origin; extra_charge marks a stated surcharge (no mark means no information, not free). Identify the hotel by its hoteldiscount24.com URL (e.g. from search_hotels), or by name plus place_id; other_matches lists similar names at that place.

language.description: The user's language: de, en or tr (default en).

name.description: Hotel name, if no URL is known (needs place_id).

name: get_hotel_facts

stars.description: Star category as listed by the hotel.

title: Amenity profile of a hotel
